components.text: Awakens the magic in the one on the centre: they become a witch or, with a 25% chance (a server setting), a siphoner.
The target stands on the centre (the caster if nobody does). It is refused for vampires, hunters, anyone who already has a species and anyone who is not human.

The roll is made when the rite runs. A refusal is shown to the caster and gives the ingredients back.

Circle: small circle, ritual chalk.
